title: 第13章 见梅姐
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳开启透视眼，透过一栋楼房，可以看到里头正设了几处赌厅，此时那里正有不少人在玩。

    他轻轻摇了摇头，语气坚定：“嫂子，你在车上等我就好，我很快就出来。”

    说完，他推开车门，径直朝着山庄门口走去。

    宋萌萌连忙追下车，伸手抓住他的胳膊，脸上满是焦急，语气带着恳求：“陈阳，你要冷静一点，这里真的很危险……

    你这样冲动，会失去更多东西的！”

    陈阳转身看着她，眼神温和却坚定：“嫂子，我现在很冷静，你就安心在车上等我，等我好消息。”

    说完，他轻轻抽回自己的手，快步走到山庄门口的西装男面前，低声说了几句。

    那西装男上下打量了他一番，确认无误后，点了点头，转身领着他走进了山庄深处。

    “陈阳……”宋萌萌看着陈阳消失的方向，脸上满是失望和担忧。

    她一时都担心这里藏着什么亡命之徒。

    早知如此，她就不带他来了。

    宋萌萌转身回到车上。

    时间一分一秒地过去，转眼一个多小时过去。

    山庄处却依旧不见陈阳出来，宋萌萌心里的担忧越来越强烈，坐立难安。

    她终究还是忍不住推开车门，朝着山庄门口走去，想问问门口的西装男陈阳的情况。

    就在这时，山庄深处的出口突然走来一道熟悉的身影，身形挺拔，正是陈阳。

    他脸上带着几分轻松，步伐稳健，身上还多了一个鼓鼓的黑色袋子，看起来心情不错。

    宋萌萌一眼就认出了他，连忙快步冲上前，紧紧抓住他的手，语气里满是急切和后怕：“陈阳，你怎么这么晚才出来？可吓死嫂子了，我还以为你出什么事了！”

    陈阳笑了笑，语气轻松：“没事嫂子，让你担心了，我们走吧。”
content_en:
Chen Yang opened his clairvoyance eyes and could see through a building that there were several gambling halls inside, where many people were playing.

He shook his head slightly and said firmly: "Sister-in-law, just wait for me in the car. I will be out soon."

After saying that, he opened the car door and walked straight towards the entrance of the villa.

Song Mengmeng quickly got out of the car and reached out to grab his arm. Her face was full of anxiety and her tone was pleading: "Chen Yang, you need to calm down, it's really dangerous here...

If you are so impulsive, you will lose more things!"

Chen Yang turned around and looked at her with gentle but firm eyes: "Sister-in-law, I'm very calm now. Just wait for me in the car and wait for my good news."

After saying that, he gently withdrew his hand, walked quickly to the man in suit at the entrance of the villa, and whispered a few words.

The man in the suit looked him up and down, and after confirming that he was correct, nodded, turned around and led him into the depths of the villa.

"Chen Yang..." Song Mengmeng looked at the direction where Chen Yang disappeared, her face full of disappointment and worry.

She was worried for a moment that there were some desperadoes hiding here.

If she had known this, she would not have brought him here.

Song Mengmeng turned around and returned to the car.

Time passed by minute by minute, and more than an hour passed in the blink of an eye.

Chen Yang still didn't come out of the villa. Song Mengmeng's worry became more and more intense and she couldn't sit still.

After all, she couldn't help but push open the car door and walked towards the entrance of the villa, wanting to ask about Chen Yang, the man in suit at the door.

At this moment, a familiar figure suddenly came from the exit deep in the villa. He was tall and tall. It was Chen Yang.

There was a bit of relaxation on his face, his steps were steady, and he had a bulging black bag on his body. He seemed to be in a good mood.

Song Mengmeng recognized him at a glance, and rushed forward quickly, grabbing his hand tightly, her tone full of urgency and fear: "Chen Yang, why did you come out so late? My sister-in-law was scared to death, I thought something had happened to you!"

Chen Yang smiled and said in a relaxed tone: "It's okay, sister-in-law, I made you worry, let's go."
